businesses.business: heavy civil construction and construction materials

offering_description.value: Builds and rehabilitates transportation, water and other civil infrastructure for public agencies and private owners. It manages and performs work on project sites and produces aggregates and asphalt paving materials at its own facilities for its projects and for sale to other contractors.

primary_products.value: Construction aggregates; hot-mix asphalt; liquid asphalt; recycled construction materials

primary_services.value: Heavy civil construction; road paving and rehabilitation; water infrastructure construction; water well drilling and rehabilitation; site development

customer_segment.value: B2G: State transportation departments, federal agencies, municipalities and public water districts; B2B: Private infrastructure owners, utilities, developers and construction contractors

end_markets.value: Surface transportation; water and wastewater infrastructure; aviation infrastructure; commercial and industrial site development

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Construction, rehabilitation and drilling work under public and private contracts; product sales: Aggregates, asphalt and recycled materials sold to contractors and other external buyers

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses crews, equipment and materials to build infrastructure for public agencies and private owners; raw materials: Extracts and processes stone, sand and gravel for contractors and internal construction crews; OEM / manufacturer: Processes aggregates and asphalt binder into paving mixes for contractors and internal crews; asset operator: Operates quarries and asphalt plants that supply contractors and internal crews
value_chain_position.category: service provider; raw materials; OEM / manufacturer; asset operator

geography_served.value: US national: Projects across the United States, with materials operations in selected regional markets

specialization.value: related lines: Heavy civil construction, water well services and construction materials production

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Public bids, proposals to private owners and direct materials sales to contractors; own locations: Quarries and asphalt plants where contractors can pick up materials

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Construction and quarrying subject to OSHA and MSHA safety rules, environmental permits and public procurement requirements
